newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 10.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 10.

text.p: Here are the leading headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon broadcast on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis on Wednesday met with American Secretary of State Madeleine Albright to discuss American support for Lithuania and concrete security guarantees.
- The Centre Union Party has submitted a proposal to amend Lithuania's constitution to allow citizens living in the country for under three years to run for president.
